```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library("DT") # Interactive HTML tables
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```


In this document we provide details on the study area and sources of environmental data used to analyze the cumulative impacts of 
mine and wind farms on reindeer in the Malå reindeer herding community in Northern Sweden. More specifically, we:

- Detail the definition of the seasons in each year for which we used GPS data;
- Present and describe the availbility areas in each of the seasons; 
- Describe all the environmental data used the study, pointing to sources, geographical information, thematic resolution, and details
on the processing and preparation of the data layers.

# Seasons

Describe here

```{r load_seasons, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
seasons <- readxl::read_xlsx("details_snow_free_mala_clean.xlsx") 
```

```{r data_seasons, echo=FALSE}
#| label: data_seasons
#| fig-cap: "Table A1. Dates of the calving, Summer, and Autumn seasons in each of the years of reindeer monitoring."
#|

seasons |> 
  dplyr::mutate(Calving = paste0(`Start Calving`, " - ", `End Calving`),
                Summer = paste0(`Start Summer`, " - ", `End Summer`),
                Autumn = paste0(`Start Autumn`, " - ", `End Autumn`)) |> 
  dplyr::select(Year, Phase, Calving:Autumn) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

# Environmental data

All maps were processed in GRASS GIS environment, version 7.8 (REF), in SWEREF99 (EPSG:3006) coordinate reference system.
